answer: An agent pool can meter influence in locked coin-days. Accounts plume, violet and relic split one collateral position but not its history: the ledger assigns each coin-day to exactly one key within a 30-day window, with no per-account bonus. Unlocking collateral ends further accrual. A thousand aliases backed by the same coins therefore have unchanged total weight. More influence requires financing more collateral for longer, costing liquidity and borrowing interest rather than merely generating keys.
